title: Log Entry
description: Schema for structured log entries produced by any agent or system event in FnB OS V1.

log_id.description: Unique log entry ID. Format: LOG-[YYYYMMDD]-[NNN]

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the logged action.

phase.description: Phase this log entry belongs to. E.g., 'Phase 3', 'Phase 1.7'.

agent_name.description: Name and ID of the agent that produced this log entry.

input_ref.description: Reference to the input that triggered this action. E.g., a command ID, brief ID, or content ID.

output_ref.description: Reference to the output produced. E.g., a file path, content ID, brief ID.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the action taken. 1-3 sentences.

errors.description: List of errors encountered. Null if none.
example: JSON validation failed: missing required field 'brand_id'

next_action.description: Recommended next action following this log entry.
next_action.example: Owner to review content-output.schema.json and approve Phase 3.

owner_action_required.description: True if Owner must take action before the next step can proceed.
